column1: # Every qualifier that takes a number, and the numbers around 16 and 32 bits (#61). {} is where
# the number goes. gen_aapt2_configs.py puts each template with each value in
# golden/aapt2/configs.tsv, and Aapt2Config.NumbersPast16Bits wants every one of them there, and
# hydroid to reject each past 65535. Add a template or a value here, then make configs.tsv again.
